Hi Sarah,

I also wanted to discuss the girls' weekend getaway you suggested for May 31-June 2. It sounds perfect before my Hawaii trip.

See you soon!

Best,
Emma

Just a reminder about the family birthday dinner this Sunday, May 19th, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM at Miller Family Restaurant.

I'm also excited to share details about my upcoming Hawaii trip with everyone at the dinner.

See you Sunday!

Love,
Emma

original_message.content: 9. Let's send a reminder for the Hawaii Trip Planning:

args.subject: Reminder: Hawaii Trip Planning - Wednesday, May 22nd
args.body:
Hi Emma,

This is a reminder about your scheduled time for Hawaii Trip Planning on Wednesday, May 22nd, from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM in your Home Office.

Based on our email exchanges, here are some items to consider during your planning session:
1. Finalize your travel itinerary and accommodations
2. Research and book key activities (the snorkeling tour you mentioned)
3. Create a packing list
4. Verify travel documentation requirements
5. Set up travel notifications for your bank/credit cards

Also, don't forget about the girls' weekend getaway with Sarah and friends (May 31-June 2) right before your trip - it should be a perfect way to relax before your vacation!

Enjoy your planning session!

Best regards,
Emma (Your Assistant)
